name: Browserless Cloud Free
free_limit: 1,000 browser units per month; up to 2 concurrent browsers and 2 minutes per session. One unit covers up to 30 seconds of browser time; proxy traffic and CAPTCHA solving also consume units.
watch_out: Free Cloud usage is capped: requests are rejected after the monthly unit allowance, rather than billed as overages. Residential proxy traffic uses 6 units/MB, datacenter proxy 2 units/MB, and successful CAPTCHA solving 10 units. Do not confuse hosted Cloud Free with the separately licensed SSPL self-hosted edition; commercial-use permission for Cloud Free is not explicitly confirmed.
